title: ContainerFile
description: The details of a file to mount in the container. One of 'source', 'content', or 'binaryContent' must be provided.

mode.description: The optional file access mode in octal encoding

source.description: The relative or absolute path to the content file

content.description: The inline content for the file. Only supports valid utf-8.

binaryContent.description: Inline standard-base64 encoded content for the file. Does not support placeholder expansion.

noExpand.description: If set to true, the placeholders expansion will not occur in the contents of the file.
